statements.sql:
SELECT TABLE_NAME
                    FROM "{catalog}".INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
                    WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ?
DESCRIBE TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."posts"
SELECT "Id", "OwnerUserId", "ParentId", "PostTypeId", "CreationDate" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."posts" LIMIT 1000
DESCRIBE TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."votes"
SELECT "Id", "PostId", "UserId", "VoteTypeId", "CreationDate" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."votes" LIMIT 1000
DESCRIBE TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"
SELECT "Id", "Reputation", "CreationDate" FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users" LIMIT 1000
SHOW IMPORTED KEYS IN TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."posts"
SHOW IMPORTED KEYS IN TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."votes"
SHOW IMPORTED KEYS IN TABLE "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"

SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "Id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."posts"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "Id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."votes"
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "Id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "Id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"
SHOW TABLES LIKE ? IN SCHEMA "{catalog}"."{schema}"
SHOW TABLES LIKE ? IN SCHEMA "{catalog}"."{schema}"
SHOW TABLES LIKE ? IN SCHEMA "{catalog}"."{schema}"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("CreationDate") as min_date,
  MAX("CreationDate") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."votes"

SELECT "Id", "CreationDate"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."posts"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE "Id" IS NOT NULL AND "CreationDate" IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "CreationDate"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."votes"
  ON "PostId" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "CreationDate" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND "CreationDate" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "CreationDate" <= ?
AND "CreationDate" > ?
